hypothesis: under Set Slow Motion(f) the tick still paces rule evaluation and Total Time Elapsed advances 16*f/100 ms per tick (P8m lines: 8, 14.4 and 16 ms at f=50, 90, 100), and Wait seconds map to ticks in that scaled time, so rounding still rounds up to a whole tick (P8w lines: elapsed_ms is the requested ms rounded up to a multiple of the scaled tick). The f=100 control repeats the P1 readings.
notes: Three complete captures agree and disagree with the scaled-tick hypothesis. The client version was read on 2026-11-03. One separate attempt was discarded after an accidental character input. Inspector timestamps have one-second precision and do not independently measure wall time. Raw ASCII logs were received through UU Remote file transfer; the active log appeared empty until the game restarted. The game visibly slowed under factors 50 and 90 while the Inspector readings stayed identical to f=100: the slow-motion rate scales the whole simulation, including the Inspector clock, so rules cannot observe it. P8 measures game time only; the wall-clock ratio needs an external timer and is not measured.
